INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for Information.

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Comprehension.

3. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

4. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading for Comprehension: Poetry.

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

6. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

7. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

8. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.

9. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation.

10. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.

11. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversation skills- Negotiation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Extensive reading – short stories and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.3.1 Essay writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Presentation Skills – Public speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information – Plays and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
